dedupe_keys.name: prociv ocorrencias em aberto open civil protection occurrences in mainland portugal anepc api

description: ProCiv - Ocorrências em aberto is the open data entry for the live occurrences handled by Portugal's National Emergency and Civil Protection Authority (ANEPC). The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the authority has published operational data on the internet since 2007, pioneering this among its peers, with a map of occurrences in progress by district of mainland Portugal and further detail per occurrence; the metadata list two API resources, the history of an occurrence and the history of occurrences by location, with continuous frequency and a Creative Commons Attribution licence, while the metadata themselves were last updated in 2021. Coverage is mainland Portugal. Access is free through the APIs. Caveats: the API endpoints and their current fields were not tested, archive depth is not stated, and occurrence types range from rural fires to road accidents and floods. It supports emergency response analysis and hazard event records, such as wildfire occurrences near roads and power lines. Related records: data-portugal-national-road-network and data-anacom-geo-coverage-portugal give the networks that such events affect.
